title: CommitteeParams
description: FOMC committee vote parameters. SPEC-COMM-3: the per-member preferred-rate formula is `inertia * lagged_rate + (1 - inertia) * (neutral_rate + inflation_coef * gap_inflation - output_coef * gap_unemployment)`. Per-member coefficients live on each CommitteeMember; this file holds only the committee-wide constants. SPEC-COMM-4: dissent_tolerance removed; each member now carries their own compromise_band.

neutral_rate.description: The nominal policy rate the committee would set at target inflation and natural unemployment. Anchors every member's preferred-rate computation.

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target used by all members when computing the inflation gap.

target_unemployment.description: Natural rate of unemployment used by all members when computing the unemployment gap.

conviction_band_factor.description: Scales how much a member's conviction narrows their effective compromise band. effective_band = compromise_band * (1 - conviction * conviction_band_factor). SPEC-COMM-5.
